labelled_by: Claude Code (the build engineer), checking each cited line in the diff on 2026-11-15; a person on the team should re-label before the numbers are quoted
meaning: real = what the finding says about the code is true; false_positive = it is not; unclear = speculative, cannot be confirmed or refuted from the diff. Precision = real / (real + false_positive).
model: qwen3.8-27b on Vultr Serverless Inference, prompt prosecutor-v2

findings.label: false_positive
findings.claim: The generator invokes the collector twice per formatter, causing duplicate diagnostic reports.
findings.note: It does run twice, but the first run passes reportDiagnostic: null, so diagnostics are reported once.

findings.label: false_positive
findings.claim: The partial check only inspects syntax nodes, so a partial class from a referenced assembly is rejected.
findings.note: The formatter must be declared in the compilation being built; a class from another assembly cannot be completed by the generator, so rejecting it is right.

findings.label: false_positive
findings.claim: The generated formatter class is not marked internal, which can cause visibility conflicts.
findings.note: In C#, parts of a partial class may omit the access modifier; only two different modifiers conflict.
